summary: Batch inventory reconciliation timed out after 30s during peak shift handoff, delaying pallet receiving scans for 45 minutes.
Duplicate ASN payload caused Inventory-Sync-API retry storm and stalled outbound dock door assignment.
Zebra printer firmware mismatch after overnight patch caused intermittent barcode formatting errors on cold-chain lanes.
Temporary contractor badge provisioning failed role-mapping sync; resolved via self-service directory refresh.
Intermittent scanner lag reported by floor supervisor; network packet logs inconclusive.
